newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: FCC in 32.5m stg London share purchase.
newsitem.headline: FCC in 32.5m stg London share purchase.

text.p: First Capital Corp (FCC) said it had entered into a sale and purchase agreement to buy 20.3 million shares in Benchmark Group Plc for 32.5 million stg in cash.
The deal would give FCC a 33.7 percent stake in property investment firm Benchmark, FCC said in a statement issued late on Thursday.

Benchmark, controlled by Hong Leong Co (Malaysia) Berhad, earlier announced it had been granted options to acquire 10 properties in London from London Capital Holdings (LCH), a wholly-owned subisidiary of Friends' Provident Life Office (FPLO), for 113.9 million stg.
FCC said part of that consideration is to be satisfied by issue of 41.4 million new shares to LCH. FCC has in turn agreed with LCH and FPLO to buy 20.3 million shares from LCH.

FCC said it would finance the deal from internal resources and bank borrowings. The FCC statement said the acquisition was a good opportunity to expand its property intersts beyond the Asia Pacific and would open a new area with growth potential.

It noted that Quek Leng Chan, chairman of Benchmark, is also a director and chief executive officer of FCC and executive chairman of Hong Leong Group Malaysia, and directly or indirectly a substantial shareholder of all three.
After the various issues and sales, Hong Leong's 47.6 percent interest in Benchmark will be reduced to 1.3 percent. LCH will hold 35 percent. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
